policies.text: Monthly volume accreditation requires completing a minimum of 80 express passenger transfers each month.
Executive route allocation is awarded to any transit provider holding tier-one carrier authorization while operating an active fleet size of at least 25 motorcoaches.
Master corridor designation is assigned to any entity holding monthly volume accreditation that also obtains cross-border service authorization.
Airport lounge hospitality designation requires an annual catering expenditure of at least 250,000 EUR.
Priority terminal shuttle assignments are given to carriers meeting high-capacity volume standards that also secure executive route allocation.
Network connectivity approval is granted to any enterprise possessing regional transit clearance that is also granted priority terminal shuttle assignments.
Automated dispatch rights are granted to firms with master corridor designation that also deploy a GPS fleet tracking system.
High-capacity volume standards are fulfilled when a company completes 100 or more express passenger transfers monthly.
VIP charter qualification is given to operators with high service recognition that also achieve executive route allocation.

Regional transit clearance is granted to an entity holding a regional transit operator permit alongside ISO 39001 road traffic safety certification, or earning a customer service rating of at least 4.5 stars annually.
Tier-one carrier authorization is granted when a operator possesses ISO 39001 road traffic safety certification or achieves an annual safety compliance rating of 90 percent or greater.
Selection as regional logistics coordinator requires automated dispatch rights and operation of at least 2 regional maintenance hubs.
Express corridor access is given to any train company possessing a high-speed passenger rail licence.
Upkeep funding compliance is granted to shuttle providers establishing a fleet maintenance budget of 100,000 USD or more per year.
High service recognition is conferred on transport firms maintaining an annual customer service rating of 4.0 stars or higher.
Cross-border service authorization is awarded to providers holding tier-two logistics recognition who carry commercial liability insurance coverage of 3,000,000 USD or more.
Tier-two logistics recognition requires network connectivity approval along with a monthly on-time performance of at least 90 percent.
Deep-sea marine certification is awarded to shipping firms that possess an active cargo fleet payload of at least 500 TEU.
